thread:
Kira: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands — quick recap and outstanding asks. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example/ah/apr-2026-recording and https://redwood.example/ah/apr-2026-slides.

Omar: Short clarification on Dedicated GA timeline: we pushed the public GA to Sept 10 to finish autoscale polish. Internal canaries start Aug 25.

Nina: Product priorities confirmed: (A) Dedicated GA (B) Optimize cost tools beta (C) Private pilot scale. Owners: Ravi/runtime, Maya/infra, Tess/support.

Ravi: Runtime notes: kernel autoprobing and cache eviction fixes landed on main. Still testing long-context perf. I'll open a rollout checklist PR with benchmarks.

Maya: Infra: capacity planning ticket created -> https://go.redwood/tickets/INF-482. Adding monitoring dashboards for queue latency.

Tess: Support/customer ops will draft GA migration checklist and common troubleshooting steps. Need sample customer configs from eng.

DevBot: Reminder: feature-flag "int8-dedicated" toggled off in prod. Toggle request requires 2 owner approvals and a runbook update.

Kira: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Ravi: Rollout checklist PR + benchmarks by Mon (2212580000)
- Maya: Dashboards + capacity numbers by Wed (2212660000)
- Tess: Migration checklist draft by Thu (2212740000)
Please drop links in this thread and attach Asana tasks.

Omar: Customer ask: will we support LLM adapters and custom tokenizers on Dedicated? Short answer: yes, with caveats. We'll document supported extensions.

Ravi: Adapter support OK but constrained by memory/kv-sharding. We'll add "recommended" adapter patterns to the runtime docs.

Maya: For custom tokenizers we need to validate compatibility with batching; add tokenizer tests to perf suite.

Nina: Also: pricing note — Dedicated GA will include a usage-based overage meter for burst. Finance to finalize numbers next week.

Kira: Please add a "risk register" line for each action: what could fail and rollback plan. Put that in the PR description.

Tess: I'll put the initial comms draft in #marketing-review and link it here when ready.

Ravi: Volunteers needed for long-context perf runs Aug 18-22. Pinged eng-runtime.

Maya: Sharing loadtest helper:
```
./tools/loadgen --scenario=dedicated-ga-longctx --rps=500 --duration=30m
```

Kira: Thanks all. I'll run a short follow-up sync tomorrow at 09:30 PT — calendar invite coming. If anything blocks, @Kira direct message me.

Omar: :thumbsup:

Nina: noted.

DevBot: Scheduled cron job: perf-report-gen -> next run 2026-08-16T02:00Z.
